songs.title: Ravana Tandavam
songs.artist: A.R. Rahman, G. V. Prakash Kumar, Anirudh Ravichander
songs.description: Ravana Tandavam from Ramayana composed by A.R. Rahman

lyrics.text: 🔥 [Intro - War Drums & Conches]
Hey Om, Hey Om... Hey Hey Om, Hey Om...
Jatatavigalajjala Pravahapavitasthale
Galevalambya Lambitam Bhujangatungamalikam
Damaddamaddamaddama Ninadavaddamarvayam
Chakara Chandatandavam Tanotu Nah Shivah Shivam
🔱 Shiva...!
Gharar Gharar Jharar Samar Asur Pasar Jai Jai!
Chalat Hilat Karak Khilat Vikat Milat Jai Jai!
Shakra Vijita, Shakra Vijita, Shakra Vijita, Jai Jai!
Darsha Darsha Ravana Darsha!
Ra Ra Ra Ravana... Ra Ra Ra Ravana...
Ravana... Ravana... Ravana...
Dainyam Varsham Ravana
Jagatam Jagatam Bhramsham
⚡ [Fierce Tandavam Beats & War Chorus]
Gharar Gharar Jharar Samar Asur Pasar Jai Jai!
Shakra Vijita, Shakra Vijita, Jai Jai! Ravana!
⚡ [Grand Orchestral Climax]

songs.title: Anthaathi
songs.artist: Govind Vasantha, Chinmayi Sripaada, Bhadra Rajin, M. Nassar
songs.description: Anthaathi from 96 composed by Govind Vasantha

lyrics.text: 🎵 [Intro - Ambient Drone]
Peranbe... Kadhal...
Ulnokki aadugindra aadal sathaa... Aaraadha aaval...
Yethetho saayal yetru thiriyum kadhal... Prathyega thedal...
Theeyil theeraatha kaatril... Pul poondil puzhuvil ulathil ilathil...
Thaane ellaamum aagi naam kaanum aruvame... Ithyaathi kadhal...
Illaatha pothum thedum thedal sathaa... Maaraadhu kadhal...
Mandraadum pothum maattru karuthil modhum maalaatha oodal...
Naam intha theeyil veedu kattum theekuchchi!
Naam intha kaatril oonjal kattum thoosi!
Naam intha neeril vaazhkai oattum neer poochchi!
Naam intha kaambil kaamathin rusi...
Kadhal kanneeril silanthi... Kadhal vinmeenin meganthi...
Kadhal meiyaana vathanthi... Kaalanthorum thodarum diary...
Kadhal deiveega ethiri... Kadhal saaththaanin visiri...
Kadhal aanmaavin pulari... Vaazhnthu petra degree...
Oar... vidaikulle... Vinaavellaam... pathunguthey aaa...
Naan... karainthathey... marainthathey... mudinthathey aaa...
🎻 (Melodic Strings Interlude)
Konjum pooraname vaa... nee... Konjum ezhilisaye...
Panja varna bootham nenjam niraiyuthey... Kaanbathellaam kadhaladi...
Kadhale kadhale... thaniperunthunaiye...
Kooda vaa kooda vaa... pothum pothum...
Kadhale kadhale... vaazhvin neelam...
Pogalaam poga vaa... nee...
Aaa... Thigampari... Valampuri... Suyambu nee...
Aaa... Prahaaram nee... Prabaavam nee... Pravaaham nee...
Aaa... Srungaaram nee... Aangaaram nee... Oangaaram nee...
Nee... Anthaathi nee... Anthaathi nee... Anthaathi nee...
🎻 (Govind Vasantha Signature Violin Solo)
📜 [Dialogue - Theda vendam mun arivi...]
✨ (Instrumental Outro)
